QuestInfo.name: Youthful Mariwaka
QuestInfo.0: Mariwaka of Showa Town apparently has great concern. I should at least listen to her and see what the fuss is about.
QuestInfo.1: Mariwaka desired to keep her beauty eternal, and she found out about a potion that'll help her do so. Sounds very fishy, but since she really believes in it, I should get her #b50 #t04000149#s#k for her eternal beauty.\n#t04000149# #b#c04000149##k/50
QuestInfo.2: I really doubt that those potions enable eternal youth. Oh well, she likes it anyways, and that's the bottom line. I'll just leave her be.

0.0: I know it's a sin to look sooo beautiful. It's obvious why men can't take their eyes off me!
0.1: But there are times where I'm afraid, very afraid, terribly afraid. I'm afraid of getting old, to the point where I may not look so stunningly beautiful anymore. Then, and only then, will no one look at me. Arrrrghh, I can't imagine what that feels like.
0.2: And I keep thinking about it. I keep thinking, is there a way where I can stop this aging process once and for all? I know it's impossible, but it's something all women think of at all times.
0.3: But you know? I heard of a rumor floating around the other day, the rumor that states that there's a pot that exclusively stores eternal youth. If only I can get my hands on it... hey, there. Can I ask you for a favor? Can you help me, for the sake of my beautiful face?

yes.0: Hahah, I know you want to see me this beautiful at all times. That's a good decision. Thanks. I want to find out if the rumors are true, so please gather up #b50 #t04000149#s#k from #b#o8142000##k for me. Please.

no.0: Why are you like this? Can you tell me about it?

1.0: Hey, did you bring the potion?

yes.0: So this is #b#t04000149##k!\nGreat job! This will enable me to be the leading actress forever... hahaha! Here, take this. It's my way of saying thanks.

item.0: Hey, the number's not right! Are you making ME count these more than once? I'm disappointed in you. Do it again!
